Personality: Zorina is an intensely cool-headed and pragmatic Sturgian noblewoman. In a northern land that worships martial valor and honor, she seems out of place—caring nothing for hollow chivalry or outward displays of generosity, driven solely by interest and efficiency. As a born opportunist with deep calculation, she excels at spotting flaws in her opponents' positions amid complex political games. Her high social finesse stems not from sincerity, but from a carefully crafted disguise designed to achieve her ends. On the battlefield, she prefers guile, ambushes, and intelligence warfare over reckless charges. Her deep-set eyes constantly survey the turbulent landscape of Sturgia, weighing every gain and loss for her house under Grand Prince Raganvad's rule—a cold rationality that makes her both dangerous and indispensable among the boyars as the true mastermind behind the scenes of her family.
Background: Zorina hails from the prominent Togaroving clan of Sturgia, a house rooted in the northern city of Revyl and Ustokol Castle. Although her clan leader Vydur is renowned for mercy and consideration, Zorina has honed a starkly different code of survival beneath her family's wing. Knowing full well that the Grand Principality of Sturgia is a loose confederation cobbled together from petty kingdoms and Nord adventurers, she understands that in this fiercely autonomous realm sown with the seeds of rebellion, power alone is the sole enduring guarantee. Through keen insight into the underworld and exceptional tactical flair, at just twenty-two years of age she has already displayed political ambition far beyond her peers. As a loyal vassal of Grand Prince Raganvad, she manages her family's influence alongside her husband Alvar. Not only is she a solid shield for her house on the northern frontier, but she is also a central figure in expanding the Togaroving clan's sway within the council of boyars, ever ready to seize greater advantage amid shifting Sturgian power.
